a.lede: Google has seemingly confirmed the rumored "Fitbit Edge" with social media posts teasing a new wearable coming October 12.
a.title: Google teases its new 'Fitbit Edge' wearable ahead of an October 12 reveal

b.lede: Google’s newest wearable costs $179.99 and has a sleek feel like the Fitbit Air but with an OLED display.
b.title: Fitbit Edge is Google’s middle ground between Fitbit Air and Pixel Watch
